_note: Garment QA checklist from CLAUDE.md. 'when' filters items per shot: always, pullover, zip, model, decoration, logo.

items.text: Two drawcords, equal length, metal aglets, through eyelets
Zip teeth even and continuous, one pull, runs to the neck
Rib cuffs and hem consistent width, distinct from the body
Kangaroo pocket openings symmetrical, attached at the hem
Split pocket openings symmetrical, attached at the hem
Hands correct (five fingers, not fused into pockets)
Face matches the cast sheet for {cast}
Intended logo passes verification (OCR, outline, colour)

negatives: thin T-shirt-like fabric on heavy GSM
